facilities.name: Moreno Valley Public Library — Main Branch
aliases: Main Branch Moreno Valley Public Library
facilities.description: The main branch of the Moreno Valley Public Library, operated under contract to Library Systems & Services, LLC on behalf of the City of Moreno Valley. Offers books, DVDs, public computers, free Wi-Fi, and a Veterans' Resources Center. Library cards are free to Riverside and San Bernardino County residents.

facilities.name: Moreno Valley Public Library — Mall Branch
facilities.address: 22500 Town Circle, Moreno Valley, CA 92553 (2nd floor, Moreno Valley Mall, above Crunch Fitness)
aliases: Moreno Valley Public Library Mall Branch
facilities.description: A modern library branch inside Moreno Valley Mall, opened December 2017. Includes a children's area, technology center with public computers, teen section, and self-checkout. Since opening, the branch has drawn over 200,000 visitors and hosted thousands of community programs.

facilities.name: Moreno Valley Public Library — Iris Plaza Branch
facilities.address: 16170 Perris Blvd, Moreno Valley, CA 92551 (Iris Ave. and Perris Blvd.)
aliases: Moreno Valley Public Library Iris Plaza Branch
facilities.description: Opened September 2020, the Iris Plaza branch features a dedicated technology area with gaming stations, virtual reality and robotics kits, six public computers, free Wi-Fi, and a self-checkout kiosk.

facilities.name: Lasselle Sports Park
facilities.description: A 12.8-acre city park with three natural-turf football fields, an exercise/walking track, a playground with separate areas for ages 2–5 and 5–12, picnic shelters, restrooms, security lighting, and parking for roughly 200 vehicles. Opened in 2014 as the city's first new park in over two decades.

facilities.name: Moreno Valley City Hall
facilities.hours_text: Mon–Thu 7:30am–5:30pm, Fri 7:30am–4:30pm (some Development Services counters follow separate Friday hours)
facilities.description: Home to the Moreno Valley City Council, City Manager's office, and most city administrative departments. Agendas, public records, permits, and department contacts are handled here or through the city's online portals.

facilities.name: Celebration Park
facilities.description: A 7.3-acre city park with walking trails, picnic shelters, and a playground. Hosts a walking/running club on the first and third Saturday of the month.

facilities.name: Shadow Mountain Park
facilities.address: 23239 Presidio Hills Dr, Moreno Valley, CA 92557
facilities.description: A 10-acre city park at the base of Shadow Mountain, in Council District 2, with lit softball/baseball fields, picnic areas, and barbecues.

facilities.name: Moreno Valley Community Park
facilities.description: A city park with 4 lighted soccer fields, a skate park, walking path, picnic shelters, playground, and snack bar.

facilities.name: Building Up Lives Foundation
facilities.address: 23185 Hemlock Ave Suite A, Moreno Valley, CA 92557
facilities.description: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit community support center offering food, clothing, hygiene supplies, and homelessness/rapid re-housing assistance. NOT a City of Moreno Valley facility -- an independent third-party organization that hosts recurring public events at this address. Verified DISTINCT against every scraped raw venue string attributed to this org (both existing variants explicitly name '23185 Hemlock Ave' -- neither the org's other locations, a Perris Blvd thrift store or a Sunnymead Blvd food distribution site, appear in any scraped event's venue text), so both aliases safely resolve to this single address; do not widen this alias list to cover the org name alone without re-checking that assumption if a new raw venue string ever appears without a street name.

facilities.name: Farm House Collective
aliases: Farm House Collective, 1393 University Ave, Riverside, CA, 92507, United States
facilities.description: A private event venue in central Riverside (not inside Moreno Valley's own town limits -- see lib/town-boundary.ts) hosting live music, markets, outdoor movie screenings and other community events; configs/moreno_valley_ca.json's own events.sources already includes it as a real, verified, regional events feed (farmhousecollective.com/events/?ical=1).
facilities._notes: Added 2026-10-08 (Phase 2, item 2a follow-up): owner-requested fix for lib/town-boundary.ts's classifyLocalityByText() safety tightening (an unresolved, address-shaped venue naming a different real place now excludes as 'unknown' rather than guessing 'nearby' with no distance) -- this venue accounts for 16 of Moreno Valley's 28 live upcoming events and was the one real case that fix would otherwise exclude. lat/lon geocoded via the free Esri World Geocoding Service (geocode.arcgis.com, no key), same service already used by scripts/ingest_moval_facilities.py/scripts/ingest_brookings_facilities.py for every other real-coordinate row in this project -- match score not re-checked here since this is the SAME address already independently confirmed against farmhousecollective.com and news coverage (lamag.com, raincrossgazette.com). Distance from Moreno Valley's own town center (siteConfig.townCenter, 33.9425/-117.2297): ~6.8mi, confirmed well within lib/town-boundary.ts's NEARBY_RADIUS_MILES (25) -- once seeded, these events correctly resolve via the coordinate path (classifyLocalityByCoords) as 'nearby' with a real shown distance, not the text fallback. alias is the exact, single live venue_raw string seen for this org in the `stories` table (61 rows, 2026-10-08) -- no other variant observed. hours_text deliberately left out: web sources gave inconsistent/caveated hours ("check with members of the collective"), not a single confirmed figure -- left null rather than guessed, same rule as every other unverified field in this file. No phone number found from any checked source.
